name: Slack
description: Interact with Slack workspaces to read channels, send messages, manage users, and access workspace data.
author: Anthropic

requiredEnv.name: SLACK_BOT_TOKEN
requiredEnv.description: Slack Bot User OAuth Token (starts with xoxb-). Create a Slack App at https://api.slack.com/apps

tools.name: slack_list_channels
tools.description: List public channels in the Slack workspace

tools.name: slack_post_message
tools.description: Post a new message to a Slack channel

tools.name: slack_reply_to_thread
tools.description: Reply to a specific message thread in Slack

tools.name: slack_add_reaction
tools.description: Add an emoji reaction to a Slack message

tools.name: slack_get_channel_history
tools.description: Get recent messages from a Slack channel

tools.name: slack_get_thread_replies
tools.description: Get all replies in a Slack message thread

tools.name: slack_get_users
tools.description: Get a list of users in the Slack workspace

tools.name: slack_get_user_profile
tools.description: Get profile information for a specific Slack user
